title: reconcile-open-prs-issues-662
outOfScope: Implementation changes for any open remediation Issue; each remains a separate Work Item.
Merging, rebasing, or deleting a PR/branch without its lifecycle evidence.
Release publication; #625 begins only after this reconciliation is terminal.

sources.path: GitHub open PR and Issue API state captured during this Work Item
sources.reason: Authoritative provider state for each disposition.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrect disposition could allow an unresolved finding or stale PR to contaminate the release path.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: RayIori authorized automatic execution; review output is bounded to evidence-backed reconciliation records.

preReviewWarnings: Do not use a partial implementation or linked branch as a terminal Issue disposition.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Machine-readable and human-readable records inventory every PR and Issue open at Work Item start.
Every inventory entry has exactly one evidence-backed disposition allowed by #662.
No entry is marked terminal without provider and lifecycle evidence; each unresolved finding has an explicit successor or next gate.
The record identifies whether release #625 may begin.
guidelines: Record RayIori's authorization for external GitHub actions in the Contract.
Do not alter implementation or lifecycle state outside an explicit evidence-backed disposition.

intent.problem: Open PRs and Issues must be reconciled before release without confusing superseded, partial, or delivered work.
constraints: Use provider state and archived evidence
Keep implementation fixes in their own Work Items
intent.rationale: A release can be trusted only when every open finding has a traceable terminal or actively governed disposition.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Every Issue and PR open at Work Item start is inventoried.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The machine and human records include each provider identifier once with a disposition and evidence references.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare the captured GitHub API inventory with both generated reconciliation records.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An Issue is linked to partial, stale, superseded, or archived-incompatible work.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The record identifies the exact unmet acceptance or successor rather than claiming terminal delivery.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect PR state, merge base, archived Outcome, and closure receipt before assigning a terminal disposition.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The release gate is evaluated after reconciliation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The record states whether #625 may begin and lists any remaining blocking Work Items without changing release state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Validate all open entries have one allowed disposition and independently inspect release Issue prerequisites.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized automatic execution and requested the approval be recorded in every Work Item Contract.
